title: Inghams Enterprises Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of the remaining 60% of shares in Aldinga Table Turkeys Pty Ltd.

body_sections.Summary: Inghams Enterprises Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Aldinga Table Turkeys Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The effect of the acquisition was examined in the national market for the wholesale supply of processed turkeys.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition for the following reasons: a. Aldinga's small market share; b. the likelihood for the exercise of countervailing power by foodservice and supermarket chains; and c. potential competition from foods with a measure of substitutability.
